text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is a deserted island somewhere at 
sea. Leaving a stunned Mejiro McQueen 
behind, the ship sailed away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"What is the meaning of this? Telling us 
out of the blue to 'survive the night' on 
this island..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer, did you hear something?
choice_data_list:
This is a project for the academy 
newspaper...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told them what I knew—that it was for a 
variety article titled 'Ojou-sama: 
Deserted Island Survival'.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you wish to see how sheltered 
little me manages to pull through, is that 
it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I accept. As a member of 
the Mejiro family, I cannot yield to a 
mere island!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
S-Still, it is eerie. To think one must 
spend time in a place like this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaah!? A tiger!? Is that a Bengal 
tiger?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall not lose...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
First, I must formulate a concrete 
strategy. Trainer-san, please grant me 
your counsel!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What is the single most important thing to 
survive on a deserted island? Come now, do 
answer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The most essential thing for survival is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Provisions... As long as we can replenish 
our nutrients, no hardship is to be 
feared, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Understood. If I cower in fear, survival 
will be impossible. I will... discard all 
self-indulgence!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer-san, ready whenever you are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Food, is it? Would you mind bringing it 
over? I'll show you I can be hardy and eat 
whatever's served.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I would never say I'm too scared to eat. 
Be it fruit or seafood, I shall eat it 
with pride. Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Mejiro McQueen managed to acquire 
food without having to lift a single 
finger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Stamina... I see. Without limitless 
stamina, surviving would be nothing but a 
pipe dream...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, that creature resembling a 
Bengal tiger from earlier... If I were to 
clash with it, it would surely serve as 
great training..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, there are still more in the 
bushes!? Fighting something like this 
really is impossible~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please give up on my stamina. 
There is no way I could possibly... 
Eeeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen kept running while being 
chased by the beast. In its own way, this 
seemed to build up her stamina.
